input-field.name: allowBuyInListing
input-field.label: Display buy buttons in listings
在商品列表中显示购买按钮
input-field.helpText: In product listings, buy buttons are displayed beneath every product. Deactivate to display detail buttons only.
在商品列表中，每件商品下方都会显示购买按钮。关闭后仅显示详情按钮。

input-field.name: autoplayVideoInListing
input-field.label: Autoplay videos in product listings
在商品列表中自动播放视频
input-field.helpText: Videos in product listings that are configured as product media covers are played automatically. Deactivate to display the first frame of video only.
商品列表中配置为商品媒体主图的视频会自动播放。关闭后仅显示视频第一帧。

input-field.name: buildBreadcrumbByReferrerCategory
input-field.label: Build breadcrumb based on referrer category
根据来源分类生成面包屑导航
input-field.helpText: Build the product breadcrumb based on the linking category if available.
若可用，则根据链接来源的分类生成商品面包屑导航。

input-field.name: partialDataLoading
input-field.label: Load reduced product data in listings
在列表中加载精简商品数据
input-field.helpText: Product listings only load the data required by the default product boxes, including a shortened description. This reduces database load and memory usage for products with large descriptions. Only enable this if your theme and extensions work with the reduced product data in listings.
商品列表仅加载默认商品卡片所需的数据（含截断后的描述）。这能降低描述冗长的商品所带来的数据库负载与内存占用。只有当您的主题与扩展能兼容列表中的精简商品数据时才启用。

input-field.name: hideCloseoutProductsWhenOutOfStock
input-field.label: Hide products after clearance
清仓结束后隐藏商品
input-field.helpText: Products marked as on "clearance sale" are hidden, as soon as their stock depletes back to 0.
标记为「清仓」的商品，在库存降回 0 之后即不再显示。

input-field.name: showVariantOptionInSearchSuggestionResult
input-field.label: Show variant options in the search suggestion results
在搜索建议中显示变体选项
input-field.helpText: Allow the variant options to be displayed underneath the product name in the search suggestion results.
允许在搜索建议结果的商品名称下方显示变体选项。

input-field.name: findBestVariant
input-field.label: Preview best matching variant in search results
在搜索结果中预览最匹配的变体
input-field.helpText: Activate to ignore the product's "Storefront presentation > Product Listing" configuration in search results. The best matching product variant is shown instead. Filtered listings always show the configured main variant if it matches the active filters, otherwise a matching variant.
启用后，搜索结果会忽略商品的「前台展示 > 商品列表」设置，改为显示最匹配的商品变体。筛选列表始终显示符合当前筛选条件的已配置主变体，否则显示匹配的变体。

input-field.name: showReview
input-field.label: Show reviews
显示评价
input-field.helpText: Activate to show reviews
启用后显示评价

input-field.name: reviewsPerPage
input-field.label: Number of reviews per page
每页评价数
input-field.helpText: The number of reviews displayed on a product page in the storefront.
店铺前台的商品页中显示的评价条数。

input-field.name: disableEmptyFilterOptions
input-field.label: Disable filter options without results
禁用无结果的筛选项
input-field.helpText: Filter options are deactivated and cannot be clicked if they provide no results
筛选项若没有任何结果，将被禁用且无法点击

input-field.name: markAsNew
input-field.label: Mark products as 'new', for ? days
将商品标记为「新品」，持续 ? 天
input-field.helpText: Products are marked as new, if their release date does not date back past the set number of days.
若商品的发布日期距今不超过设定天数，则标记为新品。

input-field.name: productsPerPage
input-field.label: Number of products per page
每页商品数
input-field.helpText: The number of products displayed on a search page or in a product list per page in the storefront.
店铺前台的搜索页或商品列表中每页显示的商品数量。

input-field.name: beforeListPriceSnippetKey
input-field.label: Snippet key for content before list prices
划线价前方内容的文案键
input-field.helpText: The content of this translation snippet is displayed before every list price in the Storefront. Leave empty to display nothing.
该翻译文案的内容会显示在店铺前台每个划线价之前。留空则不显示任何内容。

input-field.name: afterListPriceSnippetKey
input-field.label: Snippet key for content after list prices
划线价后方内容的文案键
input-field.helpText: The content of this translation snippet is displayed after every list price in the Storefront. Leave empty to display nothing.
该翻译文案的内容会显示在店铺前台每个划线价之后。留空则不显示任何内容。
